name: Smart glasses
summary: AI glasses put a camera, microphones and open-ear speakers on your face, so an assistant can see and hear what you do and answer by voice. Meta's line (Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta, Meta Ray-Ban Display) is the main mass-market option, and Meta's Wearables Device Access Toolkit lets mobile apps use the glasses' camera and audio.
facts: Meta Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta, Meta Ray-Ban Display
Wearables Device Access Toolkit, iOS and Android SDKs
goodFor: Hands-free camera input for an agent
Voice interaction away from a screen
watchOut: Third-party access is still a developer preview
Recording in public raises privacy concerns
Tied to Meta's apps and account
